•	Various rosters available
•	Tool Allowance $35.00 paid fortnightly
•	ASAP Start !

The key responsibilities for these roles include: 
•	Spray paint and sand blast road transport equipment.
•	Preparing surfaces for paint application
•	Mix and colour match paints to meet the requirements of the job.
•	Brush touch, paint/blend any defective areas of coated items.
•	Clean work areas and spray equipment.
•	Good people and communication skills.
•	Support and endorse the company vision, mission and family values.
•	Meet deadlines & quality requirements to satisfy customer demand.
•	Perform all duties whilst adhering to WHS requirements, & always with the correct use of PPE.

Fetch Recruitment is an Australian owned recruitment consultancy, delivering long term benefits to both our candidates and clients within the built environment. At Fetch, we passionate about empowering people to take charge of their careers and realize their potential, regardless of whether this is the candidates we partner with or colleagues in our team. We are looking for a highly driven and polished Business Development Manager committed to building a lasting network of candidates and clients. 


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Due to growth and a high client demand, we have a couple of opportunities for experienced Business Development Managers to join the team. We have opportunities within the engineering and the local government divisions. The role will include, but not limited to, the following responsibilities:
Developing growth strategies and plans
Managing and retaining relationships with existing clients
Increasing client base through canvass calling, use of marketing networking and lead generation
Identifying and mapping business strengths and customer needs
Strive to achieve maximum revenue for Fetch through effective objection handling and negotiation in line with company policy

ABOUT YOU
You may already be a Business Development Manager looking for a new exciting challenge or a hungry Senior Recruitment Consultant with BDM experience looking to prove your abilities.
Demonstrated experience working within the construction, engineering or local government sectors. Previous experience managing a 360 desk and developing new business Leadership qualities is desired but not essential. 
You will be required to have 3+ years experience in business to business sales. It is important you have excellent phone sales skills and experience interacting and building relationships with businesses and corporations.

WHY FETCH?

We are big on celebrating success and have a huge focus on our culture, just to list a few benefits:
Work alongside Industry leaders within Construction, Engineering, Infrastructure and Labour Hire Recruitment
Global PSA Clients
LinkedIn Recruiter License
Highflyers Club
Quarterly Team Building
Networking functions
Yearly team trips away
Access to 6 extra annual leave days
End of month events
Quarterly awards
Microsoft Surface Pro & iPhone
Flexible working from home policy
Modern office in central Southbank location, walking distance from Flinders St Station


We will offer you fast development, support, strong internal and external training and various opportunities. You will benefit from a high salary and a very rewarding commission structure but for that we are looking for the best successful and proven sales professionals.

If you are looking for an opportunity to progress your career within a successful expanding agency, we will look forward to hearing from you.

Please check us out at www.fetchrecruitment.com.au

Plant Inspector – Perth (Full-Time)
About ACTS
Asset Conformity Testing Services (ACTS) is an established, NATA-accredited ISO/IEC 17020 inspection body delivering independent asset inspection, testing, and integrity services across the mining and mineral processing, oil and gas, manufacturing, construction, rail, and port sectors. 
We provide practical, innovative, and compliance-focused solutions, including engineering services, third-party inspections, and NDT services, tailored to support our clients’ reliability, safety, and regulatory requirements. 
About the Role
We are looking for a certified and experienced Plant Inspector to join our Perth Inspection Team to conduct Plant inspections throughout Western Australia. You will ideally have experience in a similar inspection role. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a young company and play an important role in our growth journey. 
The role includes FIFO (rostered or project-based) and Perth metro work, based out of our High Wycombe office, Monday to Friday with overtime as required.
You will work alongside project engineers, maintenance teams, HSE personnel and other relevant stakeholders to ensure all plant meets regulatory requirements and industry best practice. API510 or AICIP is essential.
Role Accountabilities
•	Perform inspections, testing, and audits on registered plant, including pressure vessels, cranes, and lifting equipment, using specialist inspection and testing equipment
•	Prepare high-quality inspection and compliance reports tailored to client and regulatory requirements
•	Use knowledge and skills, from qualifications and experience, to assess compliance in accordance with relevant WA legislation and Standards.
•	Liaise with site engineers, supervisors, and maintenance teams to prioritise remedial works.
•	Provide technical support and advice related to compliance matters to clients.
•	Liaise with Department of Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety and Worksafe on client’s registered plant assets.
What we are looking for
Applicants must possess the following:
•	API510 or AICIP Pressure equipment inspection qualifications and relevant experience in the inspections space.
•	Demonstrated experience in the inspection of cranes and lifting equipment.
•	Good understanding of all relevant Australian Standards applicable to the Plant Inspection role in Western Australia.
•	Attention to detail, report writing skills, self-motivated to comply with client reporting timelines.
•	Good written and verbal communication skills.
•	Current WA drivers’ license.
•	Willingness to travel to site as required.
Desirable Criteria
•	AINDT/ PCN/ ISO 9712 NDT qualifications/API 653 certification
•	Experience working with Tier-1 mining operators (Rio Tinto, FMG, BHP or similar)
•	Engineering background, trade qualification, or High-Risk Work Licence

•	Join an experienced, and supportive team, with genuine opportunities to contribute to and grow with ACTS

•	Exposure to diverse range of projects and clients across the WA resources and other sectors.
